text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 200, "unit": "students", "kind": "count", "span": "a class of 200 students"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 3, "unit": "groups", "kind": "count", "span": "split into 3 groups"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 2, "unit": "groups", "kind": "count", "span": "2 of them are equal in number"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 10, "unit": "students", "kind": "count", "span": "10 less than each of the other groups"}], "plan": [{"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "q4"], "out": "s1", "note": "total if the smallest group were topped up to match the other two"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s1", "q2"], "out": "s2", "note": "size of each of the two equal groups"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s2", "q4"], "out": "s3", "note": "size of the smallest group"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "number of students in the smallest group"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 2, "reason": "notes that two of the three groups are equal in size; this is already reflected by dividing by 3 groups, not used as a separate operand"}]}
